## Notes

marten-mcp is a Marten implementation of the Model Context Protocol wire format
for a stateless, tools-only server: the JSON-RPC envelope, the Streamable HTTP
headers, protocol version negotiation and the request dispatcher. The idea was
mine. An AI planned it, wrote it, tested it and security-checked it. No human
has reviewed the code, which is what `unexamined` means.

The shard is incomplete and early in its life. It is still evolving, and the
changes are made by an AI. I make no recommendation either way.
